# Subject-Logics — The Ø Traversal

## #0 — Presence before its self-description

A thought appears. It can be mistaken, forgotten, contradicted or recognised as a thought about itself. Each change occurs in the presence through which the thought was available at all. The subject's logic begins with this distinction between the fact of appearing and its determinate contents. A false self-description remains a real occurrence; its occurrence does not make the description true.

[C01's defined indefinability](../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) **defines** the distinction. `0` names the unobjectifiable subject-pole: that to which an appearance is present, including every image of the one experiencing it. Any denial of this first-person fact is itself performed in that presence. No corresponding immunity belongs to the denial's content, a remembered identity or an explanation of what the subject is.

The [core-theorems spine](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) **derives** a particular traversal from this distinction. Its six-position sequence is `0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1`, returning as `0/1`. This is one developed unit within the eight-determination field: it unfolds how the knowing relation becomes occluded, discovers its mediation and recognises itself through the field it has differentiated. The initial `0` marks the subject's priority in this account. Manifest appearing already involves its relation to what appears.

## #1 — The instrument taken as the I

Attention, memory, judgment and the activity of taking something as mine give experience a determinate organisation. The Sanskrit term *antaḥkaraṇa*, the inner instrument, names this mediating apparatus. It can itself become something known: I notice what I have attended to, question a judgment, or recognise the habit by which I claimed an experience as mine. Occlusion occurs when that describable apparatus is taken as the final knower.

QL writes the occlusion `Ø`. The slash has been fused into the zero, so a composite relation appears to be a single self-thing. In the computational compression, this is computation confused for the computer: an operation of the instrument takes the subject's office. The analogy identifies a confusion of levels; it does not make the subject a hidden material machine.

The [enacted idealism argument](../section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) **qualifies** the historical placement of Descartes here. The indubitable is heard correctly: thinking, doubting and being deceived are present. The movement into a thinking-thing gathers that presence too quickly under a determinate description. The [housed definitional file](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md) **sources** the charitable reopening: I am aware of thinking. Thinking is available through awareness; awareness is not a further conclusion manufactured by thinking.

The core's placement of Hume at the same position reads the occlusion from its other side: only impressions are found among the contents, and their failure to yield a self is taken against the subject. These are authorial diagnostic placements, not accounts of either philosopher's intentions. The [Descartes house](episteme/sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/descartes/descartes-1641-meditations/descartes-1641-meditations.md) **historicises** the cogito site while retaining its outstanding exact-edition passage debt. The fact/contents discrimination remains the essay's own argument.

## #2 — The field cut into objects

The same instrument which produces an apparent owner also discriminates the owner's world. It selects, names, compares and retains. `X` marks this field of crossings: objects as available through differentiation. `Ø` and `X` are consequently two crystallisations of the slash's activity, its apparent self on one side and its articulated world on the other. Their apparent independence conceals their common mediation.

This does not give the private ego the power to manufacture reality. The ego is already a determination within the field. A34's order of dependence—Subject/Consciousness, Mind/Objective Internality, Object—keeps idealism at full ontological strength precisely by refusing that substitution. Nor does the order describe three events happening one after another. Any account of their chronology already occurs within appearing.

The [objective-internality concept](../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** the middle field's positive reality. Memory and judgment have organisation and consequences. Their becoming inspectable does not abolish them; it allows the subject's apparent independence and the world's apparent self-givenness to be examined together.

## #3 — The slash becomes visible

`Ø/X` exposes mediation between the apparent subject and its object-field. The stroke which seemed inseparable from the self now appears as a relation: the activity through which something has become this object for this situated knower. Recognition begins to change the instrument's use because its determinations can return to the operations that produced them.

The traditional distinction between *pramātṛ*, knower, *pramāṇa*, means of knowing, and *prameya*, known, gives the page three exact offices. In the authorial QL reading, numerator, slash and denominator make those offices legible. None can simply replace another. Inspecting the means does not place the subject among the means; affirming the subject does not make the known immune to examination.

The core's symbolic comparison brings Lacan's bar and the *point de capiton*, the quilting point, into this relation. The master signifier `S1` fastens the signifying chain into a local meaning; the linking `1` performs that office in the QL synthesis. The QL argument then asks what lets the chain be present for any fastening at all. *Anusyūta*, stitched-through-ness, names the pre-quilting continuity in this authorial Śaiva refraction. The thread and the button perform different work: another button cannot supply what buttoning presupposes. The comparison is the core's declared synthesis, not an attribution of the QL subject to Lacan.

## #4 — The relations become available together

The next expression holds both sides under recognition:

$$
(0/Ø)/(1/X).
$$

`0/Ø` distinguishes unobjectifiable presence from the apparent subject. `1/X` gathers the differentiated object-field in relation to its affirmed unity. The outer slash holds these two readings together. The instrument, its self-image, its world and the presence through which they are given become available in one field. Context now includes the manner in which context has been made.

Unity here retains the differentiated field. The set-theoretic neighbour makes the work of a linking `1` inspectable: in von Neumann's construction, `0 = ∅`, `1 = {∅}` and `2 = {∅,{∅}} = {0,1}`. The singleton has the empty set as its member; it is not itself empty. QL reads this exact distinction as a formal neighbour for a mark which links without becoming identical to what it links. The empty set remains a mathematical object; unobjectifiable presence does not become a set.

The [early crossed-zero movement](../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/16-s1-p3-crossed-zero.md) **figures** the relation in one sign. This root develops the later traversal that the movement explicitly leaves open: graphic composition becomes occlusion, disclosed mediation and the simultaneous availability of their relations.

## #5→0 — The affirmed one retains its source

At `1`, the subject's relation to its differentiated world is recognised as one being. The apparent self has not won possession of the subject-pole. What was occluded as `Ø` can now be affirmed through the relations which the occlusion hid. The linking mark remains determinate while knowing its dependence; an achieved name can hold meaning without claiming to originate the field of meaning. Its provisionality is exact: the signifier can be revised while the presence through which revision occurs cannot be supplied by a replacement signifier.

The [A/C conjugate root](../section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/AC.md) **extends** this discrimination into the essay's technical and ethical field. An internality's representation belongs among the contents available for examination. Improving that representation never licenses treating the represented life as exhausted by it. Equally, functioning software does not decide its phenomenal status through a change of vocabulary. The constituted instrument remains real; the first-person fact retains its distinct office.

The traversal **returns-to** [1/0](1-0.md): the affirmed one faces the condition it cannot acquire. Its manifest return is `0/1`, presence and appearing in their recognised relation. The slash can operate again without disappearing into an owner. The field has become more available through the recognition, and every further determination remains capable of returning.
